title: Annual Freedom of Information Act Report
description: Annual Reports shine a light on agencies' administration of the FOIA by providing members of the public with detailed FOIA statistics.

contactPoint.fn: Data Management US Department of Justice (USDOJ)

distribution.description: This is a JSON API endpoint for the annual report data as it is stored in the Drupal backend. An access token is required and can be created here: https://www.foia.gov/developer/#api-key-signup
distribution.title: Annual Report JSON API

distribution.description:
Individual annual reports, in XML format, are available via an API endpoint:

/api/annual-report-xml/[agency abbreviation]/[year]

Example: /api/annual-report-xml/DOJ/2021

Access token required: https://www.foia.gov/developer/#api-key-signup
distribution.title: Annual Report XML API by Year and Agency

distribution.description:
These compressed files are complete archives of the FOIA Data sets for the years 2008 through current.

Example: https://www.foia.gov/2020-FOIASetFull.zip
distribution.title: Annual Report XML Downloads by Year
